schema.text: What improvements would most encourage you to walk more often or for longer distances?

options.text: Better-maintained and cleaner sidewalks and public spaces
More shade, trees, or green spaces along routes
Safer crossings and reduced vehicle speeds
Better separation from cyclists and e-scooters
Removing architectural barriers (curb ramps, ramps, open and safe stairways or step-free alternatives)
Longer green time at pedestrian traffic lights
Nothing — I am satisfied with current conditions

it.#What improvements would most encourage: Quali miglioramenti ti incoraggerebbero maggiormente a camminare più spesso o per distanze più lunghe?
it.#Better-maintained and cleaner sidewalks: Marciapiedi e spazi pubblici più curati e più puliti
it.#More shade, trees, or green spaces alon: Più ombra, alberi o spazi verdi lungo i percorsi
it.#Safer crossings and reduced vehicle spe: Attraversamenti più sicuri e velocità dei veicoli ridotta
it.#More benches and rest areas: Più panchine e aree di sosta
it.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Migliore separazione da ciclisti e monopattini elettrici
it.#Clearer wayfinding signs and maps: Segnaletica e mappe per l'orientamento più chiare
it.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Niente: sono soddisfatto/a delle condizioni attuali
it.#Removing architectural barriers (curb r: Eliminazione delle barriere architettoniche (scivoli, rampe, scalinate aperte e sicure o alternative senza scale)
it.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: Più tempo di verde ai semafori pedonali

fr.#What improvements would most encourage: Quels changements vous encourageraient le plus à marcher plus souvent ou sur de plus longues distances ?
fr.#Better-maintained and cleaner sidewalks: Des trottoirs et des espaces publics mieux entretenus et plus propres
fr.#More shade, trees, or green spaces alon: Davantage d’ombre, d’arbres ou d’espaces verts le long des itinéraires
fr.#Safer crossings and reduced vehicle spe: Des traversées plus sûres et une vitesse plus faible des véhicules
fr.#More benches and rest areas: Davantage de bancs et de zones de repos
fr.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Une meilleure séparation avec les cyclistes et les trottinettes électriques
fr.#Clearer wayfinding signs and maps: Des panneaux et des cartes d’orientation plus clairs
fr.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Rien — les conditions actuelles me conviennent
fr.#Removing architectural barriers (curb r: Suppression des obstacles architecturaux (bateaux de trottoir, rampes, escaliers ouverts et sûrs ou alternatives sans marches)
fr.#Sidewalks where there are none: Des trottoirs là où il n'y en a pas
fr.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: Un feu vert plus long aux feux pour piétons

de.#What improvements would most encourage: Welche Verbesserungen würden Sie am meisten dazu ermutigen, häufiger oder längere Strecken zu Fuß zu gehen?
de.#Better-maintained and cleaner sidewalks: Besser gepflegte und sauberere Gehwege und öffentliche Räume
de.#More shade, trees, or green spaces alon: Mehr Schatten, Bäume oder Grünflächen entlang der Wege
de.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Bessere Trennung von Radfahrern und E-Scootern
de.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Nichts — ich bin mit den aktuellen Bedingungen zufrieden
de.#Removing architectural barriers (curb r: Abbau baulicher Barrieren (Bordsteinabsenkungen, Rampen, offene und sichere Treppen oder stufenlose Alternativen)

tr.#What improvements would most encourage: Hangi iyileştirmeler daha sık veya daha uzun mesafelerde yürümenizi en çok teşvik ederdi?
tr.#Better-maintained and cleaner sidewalks: Daha iyi bakılan ve daha temiz kaldırımlar ve kamusal alanlar
tr.#More shade, trees, or green spaces alon: Güzergâhlarda daha fazla gölge, ağaç veya yeşil alan
tr.#Safer crossings and reduced vehicle spe: Daha güvenli geçitler ve daha düşük araç hızları
tr.#More benches and rest areas: Daha fazla bank ve dinlenme alanı
tr.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Bisikletliler ve e-scooter’lardan daha iyi ayrılmış yaya alanları
tr.#Clearer wayfinding signs and maps: Daha açık yönlendirme tabelaları ve haritalar
tr.#Removing architectural barriers (curb r: Mimari engellerin kaldırılması (kaldırım rampaları, rampalar, açık ve güvenli merdivenler veya merdivensiz alternatifler)

fa.#What improvements would most encourage: کدام بهبودها بیشتر شما را تشویق می‌کند که بیشتر یا در مسافت‌های طولانی‌تر پیاده‌روی کنید؟
fa.#Better-maintained and cleaner sidewalks: پیاده‌روها و فضاهای عمومی تمیزتر و با نگهداری بهتر
fa.#More shade, trees, or green spaces alon: سایه، درخت یا فضای سبز بیشتر در مسیرها
fa.#Safer crossings and reduced vehicle spe: گذرگاه‌های امن‌تر و سرعت کمتر خودروها
fa.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: جداسازی بهتر عابران از دوچرخه و اسکوتر برقی
fa.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: هیچ‌کدام — از شرایط فعلی راضی هستم
fa.#Removing architectural barriers (curb r: رفع موانع معماری (شیب‌راهه‌های لبهٔ پیاده‌رو، رمپ‌ها، راه‌پله‌های باز و ایمن یا مسیرهای بدون پله)
fa.#Sidewalks where there are none: ساخت پیاده‌رو در جاهایی که وجود ندارد
fa.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: زمان طولانی‌تر چراغ سبز در چراغ‌های عابر پیاده

hu.#What improvements would most encourage: Mely fejlesztések ösztönöznék leginkább arra, hogy gyakrabban vagy hosszabb távon gyalogoljon?
hu.#Better-maintained and cleaner sidewalks: Jobban karbantartott és tisztább járdák és közterületek
hu.#More shade, trees, or green spaces alon: Több árnyék, fa vagy zöldterület az útvonalakon
hu.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Jobb elkülönítés a kerékpárosoktól és elektromos rollerektől
hu.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Semmi — elégedett vagyok a jelenlegi körülményekkel
hu.#Removing architectural barriers (curb r: Az építészeti akadályok megszüntetése (járdaszegély-süllyesztések, rámpák, nyitva tartott, biztonságos lépcsők vagy lépcsőmentes alternatívák)
hu.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: Hosszabb zöld jelzés a gyalogos lámpáknál

ar.#More shade, trees, or green spaces alon: المزيد من الظل والأشجار والمساحات الخضراء على الطرق
ar.#Safer crossings and reduced vehicle spe: معابر أكثر أمانًا وسرعات أقل للمركبات
ar.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: فصل أفضل بين المشاة وراكبي الدراجات والسكوتر الكهربائي
